Vote Anywhere
Remote Polling System Simulator
Vote from where you are — at an authorized polling centre.
Request permission to vote at an authorized remote polling centre, attend in person for verification and check-in, then cast a controlled ballot.
Verified in person
A polling officer verifies your identity and checks you in before any ballot is enabled.
Authorized physical centres
Remote ballots are cast only at designated, staffed polling centres.
Your vote stays secret
Vote records are stored separately from voter identity.
This is not an online voting system — ballots are cast in person only.
